mapper.select: WITH EP AS (SELECT EP.EXERCISE_DATE,EP.VDATE,EP.MDATE,EP.EXERCISE_STATUS ,EP.FINPROD_ID,EP.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN EP WHERE EP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND EP.EXERCISE_STATUS = '01' AND EP.EXERCISE_DATE >= #{tradeDate} AND ROWNUM=1 ORDER BY EP.EXERCISE_DATE DESC,EP.VDATE ) SELECT FPA.IS_CITY_BOND ISCTZ,FP.MDATE mdate,BC1.GRADE_RESULT ZTPJ,BC2.GRADE_RESULT ZXPJ,AE.REP_INDUSTRY GBHYCODE, EP.EXERCISE_DATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FP.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BC1 ON FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BC1.O_CODE AND BC1.O_TYPE = '01' LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BC2 ON FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BC2.O_CODE AND BC2.O_TYPE = '02' LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_EQUITY AE ON FP.FINPROD_ID = AE.REP_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN EP ON FP.FINPROD_ID = EP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

WITH BVI AS( SELECT SEC_ID,VALUE_DATE,PRICE,NETPRICE FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO WHERE SEC_ID = #{finprodId} AND VALUE_DATE <= SYSDATE AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC ) select FP.MDATE,MCI.CUSTOMER_NAME ISSUER,BVI.VALUE_DATE CDATE,BVI.NETPRICE from FIN_PRODUCT FP LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI ON FP.ISSUER = MCI.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN BVI ON FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BVI.SEC_ID WHERE FP.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE} AND FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT SUM(RQD.FACETOTALAMT)FACETOTALAMT,SUM(RQD.DEALAMT)DEALAMT FROM FX_REPO_QUOTE_DETAIL RQD LEFT JOIN FX_SECREPO_QUOTE SQ ON RQD.PSEQNO = SQ.SEQNO WHERE SQ.TRUSTID = #{trustid} AND RQD.SECCODE = #{seccode} GROUP BY RQD.SECCODE,SQ.TRUSTID
